request-prompt: Remove the entire left sidebar navigation and the 'Learn More' bottom menu completely, allowing the main article content to take up the full width of the screen without distracting links.
goal: I prefer a highly minimalist, traditional search engine layout that only shows standard web pages without modern widgets, sidebars, or AI assistance.
jobs: I want to learn how to hide AI-generated images in DuckDuckGo image search results
I want to access a search page that completely removes all AI features, answers, and prompts
I want to understand how DuckDuckGo detects and filters out AI-generated images
I want to navigate to other help pages to learn how to customize my search results (e.g., blocking websites or sorting by date)
I want to search the help center to find solutions to other questions about DuckDuckGo

preference-pairs.a: I actively dislike AI-generated content in my daily life and want to permanently opt out of all AI elements, including images, assistants, and prompts, from my online experience.
preference-pairs.b: I find AI tools and content useful in some contexts and prefer to filter them out only selectively or temporarily depending on my current task.

preference-pairs.a: I care about the technical implementation details of my tools, preferring to know exactly which blocklists, algorithms, or sources are used to filter my data.
preference-pairs.b: I do not care about the technical details or open-source blocklists behind a feature; I just want the toggle to work effortlessly and accurately.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer a highly minimalist, traditional search engine layout that only shows standard web pages without modern widgets, sidebars, or AI assistance.
preference-pairs.b: I appreciate feature-rich search environments that incorporate modern interactive elements like Instant Answers, translation tools, and quick settings toggles.

preference: I prefer a highly minimalist, traditional search engine layout that only shows standard web pages without modern widgets, sidebars, or AI assistance.
